text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The cherry blossoms have bloomed first thing this New Year!
Sakura Laurel has conquered the Nakayama Kimpai!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Laurel-saaan!!
Congratulaaatioooons!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Mm-mm, uuuuugh...! Even as Class Rep, I am deeply moved by such a satisfying run!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it amazing?!
Look at my legs--!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(Even after running this much, it doesn't hurt at all!
It's not getting hot or inflamed either!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I kept running!
I'm so glad I didn't waver!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I chose courage
over regret...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Back at the Derby, you told me that I could hate you, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to return the favor.
...It's going to hurt a little.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about how Sakura Laurel felt back then,
it's only natural she'd want payback.
Bracing myself, I close my eyes—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Squeeze...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you so much for back then.
For helping me look forward again."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A late-blooming cherry blossom had finally opened, blooming with a gentle, tender happiness.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, Trainer.
Seeing as my legs are fully recovered..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It seems it's almost certain
that Brian-chan will run
in the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I saw it on the news the other day.
They say Brian-chan is a "monster," you know?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "Walking the royal road from the Hanshin Daishoten to the Tenno Sho (Spring), the monster everyone pins their hopes on, they say."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...If I enter the race,
will I be eaten?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
You're quite bold, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's make the Spring Shield,
the GⅠ Tenno Sho (Spring), our next goal.
choice_data_list: Are you sure about skipping the "Hanshin Daishoten"?
Are you okay skipping the "Hanshin Daishoten"?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I guess it depends on the time and place.
I'd definitely like to observe, though.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "I mean, doesn't 'Decisive Battle at the GⅠ' sound way more thrilling?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Because it's going to be a very special race♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so Sakura Laurel and I
set our next goal on the
Tenno Sho (Spring).
